programs.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Pacific Palace"
programs.desc: A family in Vancouver calls in a crew of house truckers to haul a beautiful two-storey house across land and water so they can have a bigger home.

programs.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Harbour House"
programs.desc: A couple in Vancouver call in a crew of marine engineers to build and sail a beautiful floating house down the Fraser River and out to sea, to get to their moorings.

programs.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Fusion: Harnessing the Power of Stars"
programs.sub_title: Fusion: Harnessing the Power of Stars
programs.desc: Humanity is closer than ever before to a perpetual clean power source after a team of scientists at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory successfully produced a nuclear fusion reaction resulting in a net energy gain.

programs.title: Breakthrough S1 - "The Great Seaweed Invasion"
programs.desc: A giant mass of floating seaweed is invading popular beaches in the US and Caribbean! At sea, the sargassum belt is a floating ecosystem, but when it hits shore it turns toxic.

programs.title: Breakthrough S1 - "ECHO: The Penguin's Bodyguard"
programs.desc: In Antarctica, ECHO - a state-of-the-art robotic penguin - uses remote sensing technology to monitor these now-endangered penguin colonies.
